summary: Transitions the pit-stop state machine from the currently active sub-object (pointer stored at this+0x8) to a new target sub-object a2. Returns without change when a2 is null or equals the current pointer. When a current sub-object exists and the operation state at this+0x184 is not a blocking state (state 4, or state 3 with the byte at this+0x190 non-zero), captures bit 0 of the old sub-object's flag byte into v4, runs loop-conditional cleanup on the old sub-object via FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall, swaps this+0x8 to a2, then either reinitializes the new sub-object via sub_4A3390(a2, 0) when the captured flag was set, or directly activates it via FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall. When no current sub-object exists, the new pointer is stored and the new sub-object is activated via FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall.

local_names.v3: current active sub-object pointer loaded from this+0x8
local_names.v4: bit 0 of the old sub-object's flag byte; selects reinit vs. direct activation for the new sub-object

operations.description: Guard: when the target sub-object a2 is null, return without any state change.
Guard: load the current active sub-object pointer v3 from this+0x8; when a2 equals it, return without any state change.
Guard: when there is no current active sub-object (this+0x8 is null), skip the cleanup path and jump straight to storing the new pointer.
Guard: read operation state v5 from this+0x184; when v5 is 3 and the byte at this+0x190 is non-zero, or v5 is 4, skip the entire cleanup-and-transition block.

Save bit 0 of the current sub-object's first flag byte into v4; this records whether the old sub-object was pending/active so the replacement path can choose between reinitializing and directly activating the new sub-object.
Call FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall(v3) to run loop-conditional cleanup/processing on the outgoing sub-object.
Write a2 into this+0x8, making the new sub-object the active one.
When v4 is set, call sub_4A3390(a2, 0) to reinitialize/set up the new sub-object after the swap.
When v4 is clear, call FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall(a2) to activate/process the new sub-object after the swap.
Function returns void; all transition paths converge without producing a return value.
